subject_bootstrap.resampling_unit: subject with all cached run rows carried together
subject_bootstrap.claim_guardrail: Bootstrap intervals are descriptive stability checks over a small n=15 paired-subject dataset, not population confidence intervals.

run_sensitivity.claim_guardrail: Run sensitivity uses cached run-01/run-03 metric aggregates; B is excluded because the DMDc LOSO baseline is subject-fold based, not run-specific.

e_horizon_sensitivity.claim_guardrail: E horizon sensitivity is still run on the macro-module proxy graph, not a structural connectome.

state_label_sensitivity.claim_guardrail: State-label sensitivity tests whether A/E depend on the PCA-quartile state proxy; it does not validate any state label as a biological state.

d_window_sensitivity.claim_guardrail: D window-size sensitivity only addresses dynamic-FC parameter dependence inside the current 8-module proxy space.

claim_guardrail: These robustness checks are in-sample stress tests on the cached LSD data. They do not replace the ds006072 cross-drug stress test, structural-connectome controls, PET receptor maps, or Schaefer/Yeo sensitivity.

rows.interpretation: Direct coarse proxy for increased coupling between unimodal/sensory and transmodal systems.
rows.caveat: Current project uses 8 modules, not the consortium atlas/Bayesian mega-analysis pipeline.

rows.interpretation: Graph-dynamic proxy for enhanced integration across broad systems.
rows.caveat: Integration metric is descriptive FC, not the exact mega-analysis posterior.

rows.interpretation: Checks whether the current data show reduced segregation/within-system coupling.
rows.caveat: The paper notes not all visually apparent patterns yielded high-confidence posteriors.
The current thalamic module is coarse and does not resolve thalamic nuclei.

rows.interpretation: Local proxy check for lower transition-control energy under LSD.
rows.caveat: This is not full receptor-informed NCT until structural connectome and PET receptor maps are added.

rows.interpretation: Tests whether the coarse receptor prior beats random receptor-prior permutations.
rows.caveat: A negative or weak result should block receptor-specific claims.

rows.interpretation: Needs striatum/caudate/putamen parcels before this can be tested.

literature_benchmark.claim_guardrail: Literature benchmarking compares directionally mapped proxy metrics to published targets; it is not a reproduction of the cited studies.
